methods.label: Find the extra time per page
methods.explanation:
Both readers read the same \(760\) pages, so compare their times for one page first. Bob takes \(45-30=15\) more seconds per page than Chandra.

That same extra time occurs on every page, so Bob's total additional reading time is
\[
760\cdot15=11{,}400\text{ seconds}.
\]
The answer is \(11{,}400\) seconds, choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
